title: The Park Rescue
text:
Last year, the small park in our neighborhood became full of garbage and broken benches. Residents complained, but nobody took responsibility for the space. A group of neighbors then decided to clean it up together on a sunny Sunday morning. By the afternoon, they had filled twenty bags with trash.

The project did not stop there. The volunteers planted flowers, repaired the benches, and asked the city council for a small budget to keep the park safe. Many people who had never spoken before became friends while working side by side. According to one resident, the park is now the place where the community meets.

questions.text: What did a group of neighbors decide to do on a sunny Sunday morning?
What did the volunteers ask the city council for?
options: A small budget to keep the park safe

questions.text: What can be inferred about the residents before the project began?
options: They felt the park was not being cared for
They wanted to sell the park to a company
They did not know how to use a bench
They were happy with the garbage

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about the effect of working together?
options: It helped people build relationships with each other
It made the city council less important
It reduced the need for volunteers
It caused more arguments among neighbors

vocabulary.definition: people who live in a particular place
people who choose to do work without being paid
an amount of money available for a particular purpose
a group of people who live in the same area or share interests

paragraph_translations: Geçen yıl, mahallemizdeki küçük park çöp ve kırık banklarla dolmuştu. Sakinler şikâyet etti, ama kimse bu alanın sorumluluğunu almadı. Bunun üzerine bir grup komşu, güneşli bir pazar sabahı birlikte temizlik yapmaya karar verdi. Öğleden sonra yirmi torba çöp toplamışlardı.

Proje burada bitmedi. Gönüllüler çiçek dikti, bankları onardı ve parkı güvende tutmak için belediye meclisinden küçük bir bütçe istedi. Daha önce hiç konuşmamış birçok insan yan yana çalışırken arkadaş oldu. Bir sakinin dediğine göre park artık topluluğun bir araya geldiği yer.
